samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) designed for use in a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU. It performs arithmetic and logical operations based on the control signals provided.</description>
    
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand input.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand input.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag for operations like SLT and SLTU.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD" value="6'b100000">Addition operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU" value="6'b100001">Unsigned Addition operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB" value="6'b100010">Subtraction operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU" value="6'b100011">Unsigned Subtraction operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND" value="6'b100100">Bitwise AND operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR" value="6'b100101">Bitwise OR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR" value="6'b100110">Bitwise XOR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR" value="6'b100111">Bitwise NOR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT" value="6'b101010">Set Less Than operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU" value="6'b101011">Set Less Than Unsigned operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL" value="6'b000000">Logical Left Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL" value="6'b000010">Logical Right Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA" value="6'b000011">Arithmetic Right Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV" value="6'b000100">Variable Logical Left Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV" value="6'b000110">Variable Logical Right Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV" value="6'b000111">Variable Arithmetic Right Shift operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI" value="6'b001111">Load Upper Immediate operation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a">Signed[a];</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b">Signed[b];</assign>
        <assign id="r">res[31:0];</assign>
        <assign id="flag">aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU ? res[31]: 1'bz;</assign>
        <assign id="zero">~|res[31:0] ? 1 : 0;</assign>
        <assign id="carry">res[32];</assign>
        <assign id="negative">res[31];</assign>
        <assign id="overflow">res[32];</assign>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        reg [32:0] res;
        
        always@(*) begin
            casex(aluc)
                ADD: res <= signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= {31'h00000000, $signed(a) < $signed(b)};
                SLTU: res <= {31'h00000000, a < b};
                
                //Shift Operations
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];
                
                //LUI Operation
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0000};
                
                default: res <= 32'hzzzzzzzz;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
